title: Nicaragua
goal: Read how forty-three years of Somoza family rule ended in July 1979, when the Sandinista Front finally overthrew the dynasty in the region's last successful armed revolution of the century.
grammar: Una vez que: marcar el punto de partida de algo nuevo

items: State how long the Somoza dynasty ruled Nicaragua.
Explain when and why the Sandinista Front was founded.
State when Somoza Debayle was finally overthrown.
Describe the new government's early reforms.
